message.content:
This looks like a CBP ruling on reusable fabric gift bags. Cotton gift bags with a drawstring would fall under 6307.90 (other made up articles), though the Christmas-themed ones could be argued as festive articles of heading 9505. CBP has generally held that gift bags are not festive articles because they are utilitarian, used to wrap gifts, and not decorative in themselves. Heading 4818 and 6305 (sacks and bags for packing goods) are the other candidates. Heading 6305 covers sacks and bags of a kind used for packing goods, with 6305.20 for cotton, and the 6305.20.00 subheading is the likely home for cotton bags. Because these are used for packing gifts, 6305.20.0000 is the best fit. I recall rulings that classified similar reusable cotton gift bags in 6305.20.0000, so I'll go with that.

{"hts_code": "6305.20.0000", "reason": "Cotton woven drawstring bags of a kind used for packing goods (gifts) are classified as sacks and bags of cotton in heading 6305, not as festive articles of heading 9505."}
